title: CiMind: Deterministic Epistemic Memory, Sub-5ms Ambient Safety Reflexes, and Longitudinal Drift Guards for Local-First Cognitive Care Research
description:
Local-first, zero-cloud, cryptographically auditable Python reference kernel (Apache-2.0, standard library only) for aging-in-place and cognitive-impairment (GDS 1–7) smart-home and assistive robotics research.

Places four deterministic verification seams around untrusted local language models and residential sensors: (1) a 4-zone epistemic memory firewall preventing patient confabulation and broadcast-media RAG poisoning, (2) pure < 5 ms camera-free fall-fusion, 590 nm circadian pathway, and 868/915 MHz LoRaWAN perimeter safety reflexes, (3) stage-, subtype- (DLB, bvFTD, dysphagia), and mother-tongue-adaptive (L2 → L1) dialogue and velocity-capped concierge rules, and (4) 21-day intra-patient Median/MAD longitudinal concordance and interrupted time-series pharmacovigilance (PV-1..PV-6) sentinels.

Non-commercial open-source research scaffold outside EU MDR Regulation (EU) 2017/745 medical-device scope; see LEGAL.md and docs/CLINICAL_AND_SYSTEMS_EVIDENCE_RATIONALE.md.
